title: Simple ZOOM X
description: Client side zoom mod for fabric
body:
WRN Zoom is a simple and lightweight zoom mod for Minecraft.

Features
- Zoom in by pressing C
- Lightweight and easy to use
- No unnecessary features
- Perfect for exploring, building, and spotting distant objects
- Works entirely on the client side

WRN Zoom focuses on one thing: providing a quick and simple zoom feature without changing the core Minecraft experience.
